Sandbox_B47HE_EnableSupportPreflightProb: Development diagnostic only; dedicated multiplayer NOT TESTED. Allows manual inspection of the requesting player's directly carried vanilla Army Walkie Talkie. No credentials, authorization, mission, item changes or combat. Defaults off in existing saves. Independent of audio flights.
Sandbox_B47HE_EnableAudioFlights_tooltip: Experimental dedicated-server audio only; multiplayer NOT TESTED. No wreck, loot or zombie attraction. Disabling cancels current audio. Unsupported SP/host modes stay silent.
Sandbox_B47HE_FlightIntervalDays_tooltip: 1-365 in-game days; default 14. The first flight waits a full interval after an eligible player is present. Restart resets the schedule; missed flights do not accumulate. Changes affect future scheduling.
Sandbox_B47HE_FlightDurationSeconds_tool: 10-180 real seconds; default 60. Changes affect future flights. Rejoining never extends the original expiry.
